## Anomaly Type Definitions for KG Mapping

Type | Definition | Detection Criterion | Ontology Class
--- | --- | --- | ---
SPIKE | Transient deviation >3 s , <5 minSingle | reading >CRIT | AnomalyEvent::Spike
DRIFT | Monotonic deviation >15 min | Slope >0.1 s /min for 5+ readingsAnomalyEvent::Drift | 
STUCK | Unchanged >10 consecutive | readings std(last 10)<0.001×nominal | AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor
OUT_OF_RANGE | Sustained WARN violation >10 min >WARN for 20+ | readings | AnomalyEvent::OutOfRange
CORRELATED | Causally linked to another station Onset within | 90 min of cause | AnomalyEvent::Correlated
